entities.name: Antonio Sancho Dávila de Toledo y Colonna
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio Sancho Dávila y Toledo Colonna, 3rd Marquis of Velada and 1st Marquis of San Román, Grandee of Spain, was a Spanish noble, soldier, diplomat and statesman. He served in the military campaigns in North Africa and in the war in Flanders and was Governor of Milan.
